title: Bounded nonlinear observer comparison on frozen Transformer trajectories
hypothesis: With specified limited predictors, adding past CLS observations improves prediction of remaining true-label NLL reduction beyond the full current representation and strong current-only references.
scope: Final bounded exploratory observer comparison in these six development-exposed auxiliary-supervised models. No retraining, reserved seeds, controller deployment, or confirmation advancement.
target: V_l = -log(clip(p_l[y],1e-8,1)) + log(clip(p_6[y],1e-8,1)); negative values retained; labels and future outputs never enter predictors.

data.exclusions: Exact counterfactual families in that model training/validation streams and U7B/U7C evaluation suites; all six T2-E1 datasets; all earlier-generated families in this study, across phases and model seeds. Mapping-order equivalences are not canonicalized.
data.grouping: Both counterfactual members share partition; all steps share partition. Main data generated only after development decision and main freeze.

eligibility: Step eligible only if main probe-training V mean and sample SD both >=0.02 nats. All steps still evaluated and reported; all six models must contribute for primary panel.

features.current: All 12x32 residual states in fixed token order plus 2 probabilities, entropy bits, margin:388 columns.
features.history: Append CLS residual32 plus probabilities2,entropy,margin at steps1..l-1:36*(l-1) columns, identical current prefix retained.
features.current_rff: Append 36*(l-1) fixed cosine random features of train-standardized current; W~N(0,1/388), bias~U(0,2pi), scale sqrt(2/h).
features.shuffle: Permute past slots independently per family, same permutation for both members; current unchanged. At step2 exact alias, no chronology evidence.
features.mismatch: Within each split, cyclic nonzero donor-family shift, retaining member index; no self-donations.
features.feature_rng: 420000000 + phase_offset + seed*100 + step; phase_offset=0 development,1000000 main.

mlp.ensemble: Average two fixed initialization predictions for each alpha/checkpoint candidate. Select candidate with lowest ensemble validation MSE; exact ties larger alpha, then fewer epochs. All candidates train full80 epochs; no adaptive extension.
mlp.preprocessing: Training-only feature means/population SD, floor1e-8; training target mean/population SD floor1e-6; float32 fitting; invert target standardization for scores.
mlp.batch_order: Common fixed epoch permutations for every arm/alpha/initialization in each seed-step-phase. sklearn shuffle=False.
mlp.rng: 430000000 + phase_offset + seed*1000 + step*10 + initialization; phase_offset0 development,10000000 main. Epoch order base440000000 plus phase_offset+seed*100+step.
mlp.matched_budget: history,current_rff,shuffle,mismatch have identical input width and 32 hidden units; identical grids, training examples, updates, checkpoint searches and two-member ensemble. Fixed-transform costs differ and are reported.

ridge_reference.selection: Train-only standardization and centering, validation MSE, ties larger alpha; no refit.

current_reference: For each seed-step, choose lowest validation MSE among current_mlp,current_rff_mlp,current_ridge,current_rff_ridge, with ties in that listed order. A necessary reference, not a claim of equal search capacity.

development.purpose: One representation-based synthetic sensitivity check, no main natural target comparisons.
development.construction: Real current and past observations from development examples. Replace first historical coordinate by independent paired Gaussian Z; preserve all other columns. g(X) is the highest training-variance current coordinate, standardized on training data. Y_delta=1+sqrt(0.5)*g(X)+sqrt(delta)*Z+sqrt(0.5-delta)*epsilon. Z and epsilon independent of each other and all real features; pair correlation0.5.
development.known_oracle: Current conditional-mean predictor MSE=0.5; history conditional-mean predictor MSE=0.5-delta. Population oracle relative MSE reduction=2*delta, i.e.0%,5%,20%. These are oracle errors; fitted gains need not equal them.
development.rng: 450000000+seed for Z and epsilon; same features/noise/initializations shared across scenarios.
development.go_rule: Null scenario must fail the complete screen and strongest20% oracle-gain scenario must pass against both required references on the one six-model panel.5% oracle scenario descriptive only. Any go-rule failure ends this study before main data are generated; no calibration tuning or retry.
development.limits: One six-model calibration panel at step2. Replaces one past coordinate and uses synthetic linear targets; does not prove power on natural NLL, all steps, or arbitrary nonlinear history signals.

aggregation.primary: Equal mean of per-cell relative MSE reductions across training-eligible steps within each seed, then equal mean across six fixed seeds. Relative MSE reduction=(MSE_baseline-MSE_history)/MSE_baseline.
aggregation.unit: Resample evaluation families within each seed, preserve both members and common draws across steps/arms; independent resampling across seeds; fitted probes and six models fixed.
aggregation.interval: 2.5/97.5 percentile conditional bootstrap; not model-population or selection uncertainty.

decision.threshold_justification: 5% lower squared prediction error is a declared research continuation threshold; it is separate from statistical evidence and is not validated controller utility.
decision.screen: Against BOTH required baselines: mean relative MSE reduction>=0.05, conditional95% lower bound>0, positive seed-level relative improvement for all six models, and mean MAE improvement>=0.
decision.classification: If calibration passed and main panel eligible: full screen pass => advantage_worth_independent_replication; otherwise if BOTH required upper95% bounds<0.05 => useful_gain_excluded_for_this_fixed_panel_and_predictor; otherwise inconclusive. An ineligible panel is reported separately.
decision.chronology: Ordered vs shuffled is secondary only at steps>=3. No chronology claim without positive ordered-vs-shuffled evidence; single-slot alias cannot count.
decision.stop: One development panel and at most one main evaluation. Keep earlier findings closed. No outcome-driven family/grid/sample expansion, retraining, reserved seeds, or automatic confirmation. Record implementation fixes and retain failed logs.

cost_reporting: float32 history storage per example; scalar transforms and extraction overhead excluded from MAC estimate
